title: Can Bond Vigilantes Prevent the Next Debt Crisis?
gist: Nouriel Roubini warns that large budget deficits and rising debt-to-GDP ratios in advanced economies are rattling bond markets as government rates have moved from near zero to much higher levels. Higher short- and long-term yields are casting doubt on debt sustainability; some countries are better protected than others, but none is immune.
